sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Importing the comparison helper
sections.what: Brings in the shared helper that turns data into a stable form for comparing. Nothing is shown to users directly.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond its use in the check below.
sections.watch_out: If the shared helper changes how it orders fields, comparison results can change too.

sections.name: assertMetadataOnlyDossier
sections.title: Checking that a repair touched only attribution
sections.what: Compares the old and new wind dossiers on the parts that must not change, such as claim values, roles and report excerpts. It ignores everything else. If anything compared has changed, it stops with an error.
sections.why: The comment says a reconciliation may repair attribution but must never silently rewrite facts.
sections.watch_out: Dates, scope, designation and references are outside the compared fields, so a repair that changes only those will pass without any error.

summary: Checks that a wind data repair changed only attribution fields and did not change any claim value, role or excerpt, and stops the repair if it did.
purpose: Acts as a safety check for reconciliation runs on wind data.
why: The comment says an explicit reconciliation may repair attribution but must never silently rewrite facts.
how: Reads the old and new versions of a wind dossier. It keeps only the parts it compares, which are claim identity fields, values, units, excerpts, line numbers, phases and field paths, plus participant names, roles, phases and claim links. It then compares the two versions in a stable form and throws an error if they differ.
inputs: Two JSON texts: the previous dossier and the proposed new dossier.
outputs: Nothing on success. On failure, it throws an error saying the reconciliation changed facts.
risks: Claim references, dates, scope and designation are not compared, so a change to them passes this check. The list of compared fields is fixed, so a field added later is not checked.
debug: If the error about metadata-only appears, compare the two files on claim values, roles and excerpts. If a change to dates or references is not caught, that is expected behaviour of this list.
